vocabulary.meaning_en: sold at a lower price than usual
vocabulary.example: These shoes are on sale this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the amount of money something is sold for
vocabulary.example: The price of this shirt is twenty dollars.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what you must give (money, time or effort) to get something
vocabulary.note_ar: How much does it cost? = كم ثمنه؟
vocabulary.example: How much does this bag cost?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give money for something you buy
vocabulary.example: Can I pay by card?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plastic card from a bank; the bank lends you the money and you pay it back later
vocabulary.example: I paid for the hotel with my credit card.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bank card that takes money directly from your account
vocabulary.example: She uses her debit card for groceries.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money in coins and paper notes
vocabulary.example: Do you want to pay in cash or by card?

vocabulary.meaning_en: an act of buying or selling; money for a product
vocabulary.example: The transaction took only a minute.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money the government takes when you buy something
vocabulary.example: Are the taxes included in the price?

vocabulary.meaning_en: really, actually, in reality
vocabulary.example: They literally take the money out of your account.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a particular design or way something looks
vocabulary.note_ar: يمكن استعمال style وkind وtype بمعنى قريب
vocabulary.note_en: style, kind and type are used in a similar way
vocabulary.example: I like the style of this jacket.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of things that are similar; a sort
vocabulary.example: What kind of shoes are you looking for?

vocabulary.meaning_en: how big or small something is (S, M, L)
vocabulary.note_ar: S = small، M = medium، L = large
vocabulary.note_en: S = small, M = medium, L = large; also XS and XL
vocabulary.example: Do you have this in a medium size?

vocabulary.meaning_en: red, blue, black, etc.
vocabulary.example: What colour would you like?

vocabulary.meaning_en: having only one colour
vocabulary.example: His clothes are monochromatic: all black.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thing that a product has, e.g. four doors or a big screen
vocabulary.example: This phone has many useful features.

vocabulary.meaning_en: why something is good for you; what it does for you
vocabulary.example: The benefit is that you save time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money taken off the price, e.g. because you buy many or the item is damaged
vocabulary.example: If I buy five, can I get a discount?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small cut or mark on the surface of something
vocabulary.example: There is a scratch on this table.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the company's promise to fix the product if something is wrong
vocabulary.example: The laptop has a one-year warranty.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop's rules about giving back products and getting money back
vocabulary.example: What is your return policy?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a paper from a shop that lets you buy other things there instead of getting money back
vocabulary.meaning_ar: إشعار دائن / قسيمة شراء بدل المال
vocabulary.example: They didn't give me my money back, only a credit note.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a paper that shows what you bought and paid
vocabulary.example: Keep your receipt in case you want to return it.

fine_lines.title: price vs cost
fine_lines.explanation_ar: price هو مبلغ المال المكتوب على المنتج. cost هو ما يجب أن تدفعه أو تبذله، وقد يكون مالًا أو وقتًا أو جهدًا. نقول What is the price? وHow much does it cost?
fine_lines.explanation_en: Price is the amount of money for a product. Cost is what you must give, which can be money, time or effort. Say "What is the price?" and "How much does it cost?"

examples.sentence: The price is on the label.
The trip cost me two hours.

fine_lines.title: credit card vs debit card
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع credit card يقرضك البنك المال وتسدّده لاحقًا. مع debit card يُسحب المال مباشرة من حسابك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: With a credit card, the bank lends you money and you pay it back later. A debit card takes money directly from your account.

examples.sentence: I'll pay the credit card bill next month.
The money left my account when I used my debit card.

fine_lines.title: sale vs discount
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sale تخفيض يقدّمه المتجر للجميع. discount خصم تطلبه أنت لسبب، مثل شراء كمية كبيرة أو وجود خدش في المنتج.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A sale is a lower price the shop gives everyone. A discount is money off that you ask for for a reason, like buying many or a damaged item.

examples.sentence: Everything in the shop is on sale today.
It has a scratch, so can I get a discount?

fine_lines.title: feature vs benefit
fine_lines.explanation_ar: feature هي ما يملكه المنتج (مثل تقليل الضوضاء). benefit هي الفائدة التي تحصل عليها أنت منه (لا تسمع الضوضاء الخارجية).
fine_lines.explanation_en: A feature is what a product has. A benefit is why that is good for you.

examples.sentence: One feature of this camera is noise reduction.
The benefit is clear sound without outside noise.

fine_lines.title: warranty vs return policy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: warranty وعد من الشركة المصنّعة بإصلاح المنتج. return policy قواعد المتجر لإرجاع المنتج واسترجاع المال.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A warranty is the maker's promise to fix the product. A return policy is the shop's rules for taking things back.

examples.sentence: The phone has a two-year warranty.
The store's return policy is 30 days.

expressions.phrase: Do you have anything on sale?
expressions.example: Excuse me, do you have anything on sale?
How much does this watch cost?

expressions.meaning_ar: نقدًا أم ببطاقة خصم أم ببطاقة ائتمان؟
expressions.meaning_en: How do you want to pay?
expressions.example: Cash, debit or credit? - Debit, please.

expressions.meaning_en: Is the tax already in the price?
expressions.example: Are the taxes included, or do I pay extra?

expressions.phrase: Does it come in another size / colour?
expressions.meaning_en: Do you have it in a different size or colour?

expressions.phrase: What are the features? What are the benefits?
expressions.meaning_en: What does it have, and why is it good for me?
expressions.example: Before I buy this camera, what are the benefits?

expressions.meaning_en: Can you make the price lower?
expressions.example: If I buy three, can I get a discount?

expressions.meaning_en: Will the company fix it if it breaks?
expressions.example: Does this laptop have a warranty?

expressions.meaning_en: What are your rules for returning things?
expressions.example: What is your return policy for shoes?

expressions.meaning_en: Don't throw away the paper that shows you paid.
expressions.example: Keep your receipt, or you can't return it.

expressions.meaning_en: said by shop workers when you leave: please visit again
expressions.example: Thank you for shopping with us. Come again!

questions.question: "These jackets are on sale." means they are ___.
questions.explanation_en: On sale means at a lower price.

questions.question: Which card takes money directly from your bank account?
questions.explanation_ar: debit card تسحب المال مباشرة من حسابك.
questions.explanation_en: A debit card takes money straight from your account.

questions.question: "How much does it ___?"
questions.explanation_ar: نقول How much does it cost؟ لأن cost فعل هنا.
questions.explanation_en: We say "How much does it cost?"; cost is the verb here.

questions.question: The paper that shows what you bought and paid is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A receipt shows what you paid.

questions.question: The company promises to fix the camera for one year. This is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: warranty وعد من الشركة بإصلاح المنتج.
questions.explanation_en: A warranty is the maker's promise to fix it.

questions.question: "This car has four doors and a big screen." These are its ___.
questions.explanation_ar: features هي الأشياء التي يملكها المنتج.
questions.explanation_en: Features are what a product has.

questions.question: The shirt has a small scratch. What can you ask for?
questions.explanation_ar: إذا كان في المنتج عيب صغير يمكنك طلب discount (خصم).
questions.explanation_en: If something is damaged, ask for a discount.

questions.question: How is "colour" spelled in American English?
questions.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية الأمريكية: color بدون u.

questions.question: The shop gives you a paper to buy other things there instead of your money back. This is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: credit note تسمح لك بالشراء من المتجر بدل استرجاع المال.
questions.explanation_en: A credit note lets you buy other things in the shop.

questions.question: What does S, M, L show?
questions.explanation_ar: S وM وL مقاسات: صغير ومتوسط وكبير.
questions.explanation_en: They are sizes: small, medium, large.
